Scope: collector and local roads; potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, TSE, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks; a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds; boundary fence, guard room and utility buildings.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 02-Nov-2026 data date the project is 21.1% complete against 36.4% planned in the baseline (SPI 0.58), and against 34.8% in the contractor's recovery plan (SPI 0.61). This week added 0.31%, all in roads and sewage, against 2.78% planned in the recovery plan.

The schedule update now finishes the project four and a half months late. The P6 update with data date 02-Nov-2026 schedules project completion on 22-Jul-2027, 139 days after the contract completion date of 05-Mar-2027 and 7 days later than last week's update. The weekly report still forecasts 05-Mar-2027 with no change to any milestone. Finishing on time needs about 4.6% physical progress a week for the 17 weeks left, against 0.31% this week.

Planned is the original baseline. Against the recovery plan (34.8% to date) the SPI is 0.61. This week's 406 earned man-hours came from roads (+260) and sewage (+146); fence, utility buildings and storm drainage did not move. The P6 update (data date 02-Nov-2026) has 1,065 activities: 302 completed, 28 in progress and 735 not started.

Scope of work: quantities

Total quantity, quantity finished and quantity remaining for the main items, from the Major Quantities sheet of the 02-Nov-2026 weekly report. "This week" compares it with the 26-Oct-2026 report: the sheet was not updated, so every item shows 0.

Finished Remaining
Scope itemAreaUnitTotalFinishedThis weekRemaining% finished
Buildings and earthworksFence and guard room foundations are almost complete and walls are at 75%. Utility building grade beams and slabs are complete, but their columns are at 24%. Embankment fill is at 41% and road subgrade at 14%; the storm pond riprap is at 45%.
Networks barely startedThe Major Quantities sheet still records no pipes, manholes, cables or ducts installed, against 5,698 m of storm pipes and 1,768 m of sewer pipes planned by this date. The inspection log for this week does record storm pipe backfilling between manholes MH-10 and MH-06, 6 storm manholes, 7 catch basins, base course and prime coat on external roads 2 and 3, and the Conclusion sheet reports 102 m of storm network executed.

The weekly report and the P6 update disagree on every open milestone. The weekly report shows all milestones on their baseline dates with zero days of change, including shop drawing and material approval (16-Feb-2026), which is still open. The P6 update moves every network past its baseline and the project finish to 22-Jul-2027, one to two weeks later than last week for every open milestone. The P6 file gives no total float values, so float is not shown.

Data notes

  • This-week values compare the 02-Nov-2026 weekly report (WPR-37) with the 26-Oct-2026 report (WPR-36) in the W05 folder.
  • The Milestones sheet states contract week 43 of 60, used as the report week. Whole weeks from site handover to the data date give 42.
  • The baseline planned progress to date is 36.4% in both weeks' summaries, so the baseline plan did not advance; the monthly chart data gives 34.3% at the end of October and 48.6% at the end of November.
  • The weekly physical columns repeat last week's values (708 planned and 445 earned man-hours, fence only). The actual gain this week (406 man-hours, +0.31%) was taken from the change in cumulative earned man-hours.
  • The Major Quantities and Procurement sheets are unchanged from 26-Oct-2026, while the inspection log records storm pipe, manhole, catch basin, base course and prime coat works this week and the Conclusion sheet reports 102 m of storm network executed.
  • The supply tracking file gives much higher supplied quantities than the Procurement sheet, uses project ID DHRT-02-01 and names a different project manager ("م/ نواف"). It lists supplied quantities for storm manholes and catch basins that it also marks as still in manufacturing.
  • The weekly report forecasts completion on 05-Mar-2027 with zero variance, while the P6 update finishes on 22-Jul-2027 (15-Jul-2027 last week).
  • In the dashboard's progress overview, the Roads and CCTV rows have their names swapped; the Progress sheet was used instead.
  • The Conclusion sheet and the dashboard label cost-based progress as "actual" progress; it is not used in this report.
  • The Conclusion sheet is headed "Dammam", reports 260,000 m³ of earthworks against 428,344 m³ in the Major Quantities sheet, and gives network lengths that differ from the Procurement sheet (for example storm pipes 4,838 m against 4,672 m).
  • The invoice summary says 3 invoices were submitted, but the invoice log lists 4 with a total of 10,524,342 SAR. The log also shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000 and an EAC of 20,900,000, which do not match this contract.
  • Several sheets carry other projects' identifiers or old dates: the QC checklist and the FIR log use project DHRT-02-001, the risk register uses DAMT-01-002 (Dammam), and the HSE inspection covers 27-Jan to 03-Feb-2026.
  • The issue log closes the advance payment issue, but the P6 update and the risk log both show it as still open.
  • The November manpower actuals (30 manual, 22 staff) repeat October's, and the dashboard's resources panel still shows January head counts.
  • The Schedule sheet still counts 1,271 activities with the same statistics as last week; the uploaded P6 file has 1,065.
  • The uploaded PowerPoint is the MODON report guide; it still states contract week 35 of 60 and was not used for figures.
